label: God
resolution: Two Lean predicates carry the word, and the case never identifies them silently. `God` (DEF-GOD-AS-NAMED-IN-THE-SUMMA) is the bearer of the name in the Summa on the maxime ens route; STMT-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD there is about it, and it rests on the nominal premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS, a reduced form of the q.13 a.8 ad 2 definition. `IsGod` (DEF-GOD-OF-CLASSICAL-THEISM) is the God of classical theism, used by STMT-GOD-EXISTS, stages 2-6 and the root. On the older stage-1 routes (CATHOLICISM-STAGE1-FROM-PRIMA-VIA, CATHOLICISM-STAGE1-VIA-MAXIME-ENS) the step to `IsGod` is the open identification premise STMT-UNIQUE-PURE-ACT-FIRST-MOVER-IS-GOD, and `God` and `IsGod` stay separate predicates. The designated Stage1 reading (CATHOLICISM-STAGE1-VIA-FULL-DESCRIPTION, now composed into root CATHOLICISM-FROM-PRIMA-VIA-WITH-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES; the earlier root CATHOLICISM-FROM-PRIMA-VIA-VIA-FULL-DESCRIPTION is preserved) has no such step and no parameter `God`: its open premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE reads 'God' as a proper name whose signification is the full source description (DEF-GOD-NOMINAL-Q13: above all, principle of all, cause of every perfection, remote from all) and applies it to `IsGod` directly, because a being that meets everything the name signifies is God in the proper sense (q.2 a.2 ad 2, DEF-NOMINAL-DEFINITION). That application is the content of the open premise, stated in the record, not an identification made silently; the reduced premise is derived from it (AQUINAS-REDUCED-DESCRIPTION-OF-GOD-SUFFICES). ST I q.2 a.2 ad 2 licenses taking what the name signifies as the middle term of a proof from effects (DEF-NOMINAL-DEFINITION), so a nominal conclusion is the expected output of a way. 'What all understand by God' (q.2 a.3) reports usage and is a premise of no root-path result; the problem-of-evil signature has a third predicate, `Sig.God`, fixed by that usage as the first mover, so a consistency result there (POE-CATHOLIC-CONSISTENT-WITH-EVIL) is about that predicate, not about `IsGod`. A reviewer who finds 'God' in a conclusion must check which predicate the Lean theorem uses. Scott's variant of Gödel's ontological argument (#134) has a fourth predicate, `GodLike` (DEF-GOD-LIKE-SCOTT): having every positive property, in the sense of the undefined constant P (DEF-POSITIVE-PROPERTY-SCOTT). Its results (SCOTT-GOD-LIKE-NECESSARILY-EXISTS, SCOTT-GOD-LIKE-UNIQUE, SCOTT-MODAL-COLLAPSE) are about `GodLike` only. No statement identifies it with `God`, `IsGod` or `Sig.God`, and where the AFP theory's glosses say 'God' its claims record the formula about G instead. Gödel's 1970 variant (#135) uses the same formula and the same Lean `GodLike` (DEF-GOD-LIKE-GOEDEL-1970), applied to its own positivity constant (DISAMB-POSITIVE); its results (GOEDEL-1970-POSSIBLE-GOD-LIKE-NECESSARILY-EXISTS and the inconsistency GOEDEL-1970-INCONSISTENT) are about that predicate only, and no statement identifies it with `God`, `IsGod` or `Sig.God` either. In the same-witness Stage1/Stage2 composition, the local Maximal predicate instantiates the generic predicate parameter of eight attribute theorems, solely to prove their properties of the selected maximal being. It is not a definition of σ.IsGod and does not infer the nominal converse. The actual σ.IsGod remains unchanged, and the ninth attribute IsTheOneGod still quantifies over every σ.IsGod instance; the original StagesOneTwo and QuartaViaClassicalWitness proofs explicitly retain STMT-GOD-IS-MAXIMAL-IN-BEING. The separate Q11-NATURE composition instead derives that ninth attribute from its three explicit individuation/nature premises. Neither route derives its uniqueness premise from maximum uniqueness alone. Fork (batch 4 of #1233, TruthCore.Causality.TermSenseForks4). The designated root route uses 'God' twice: naming (STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE) and attributes (STMT-GOD-HAS-CLASSICAL-DIVINE-ATTRIBUTES). Senses of that use: GOD_1 nominal (NominalGod), GOD_2 the Summa's God parameter, GOD_3 usage (CalledGod), GOD_4 classical (Signature.IsGod); coverage STMT-GOD-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE, exclusivity STMT-GOD-SENSE-UNIQUE. Per sense at the naming premise: GOD_1 makes it analytic (NOMINAL-GOD-NAMING-IS-ANALYTIC), so its content is the bridge STMT-NOMINAL-GOD-IS-CLASSICAL-GOD, proved equivalent to it; GOD_2 (GOD-NAMES-DESCRIBED-FROM-SUMMA) and GOD_3 (GOD-NAMES-DESCRIBED-FROM-USAGE) reach it through open bridges; GOD_4 is the premise itself. Equivocation hazard: GodNamesTheFullyDescribedPrinciple and GodIsMaximalInBeing are generic in the God predicate, and statements bind by head constant, so a theorem instantiating God with NominalGod would bind to the GOD_4 root statements while being analytic. The GOD_1 readings are therefore separate declarations (NominalGodNamesDescribedPrinciple, NominalGodIsMaximalInBeing) and statements. GOD_5 and GOD_6 (GodLike) are not readings of the route's use: world-indexed predicates over a positivity constant; they share one Lean declaration because the formula is the same and the senses differ only in the positivity constant (DISAMB-POSITIVE).
